name: Bounding Volume Empty-Space Culling
definition: A technique to restrict reconstruction computation to the 'effective' reconstruction area by calculating an initial bounding volume and slicing it according to the viewing direction, using these slices as a depth buffer to guide reconstruction.
summary: Bounding Volume Empty-Space Culling restricts volume rendering to valid voxel areas using a geometric bounding volume as a depth buffer, distinguishing itself from segment lists and fragment occlusion methods.
